change_summary: The retraction notice's Crossref title names an article on sleep quality in nurses. The tracked paper is titled 'Mindfulness training reduces exam anxiety in undergraduates'. The notice says its article was retracted because the data could not be verified. No document given shows a change to the tracked paper's content.

alerts.what_changed: The notice retracts a different article, 'Mindfulness training improves sleep quality in nurses', because its data could not be verified. Nothing in the material shows a change to the tracked exam-anxiety paper.
alerts.reason: The notice's Crossref title names a different article from the tracked paper, so the retraction does not concern it, even though the record's update-to field lists this paper.
